annotations.title: Compare Korea overseas stock vs etf tax

description: Korean tax on the same gain via overseas stocks held directly (capital gains: 2.5M deduction then 22%, separate), a domestically listed overseas ETF (dividend income 15.4% withheld; above 20M of interest and dividends the excess is taxed at the marginal rate) or such an ETF inside an ISA (2M / 4M tax-free, then 9.9%). Returns the three taxes, the cheapest and the break-even gain (~8.33M).

marginalRate.description: Marginal rate for comprehensive taxation including local tax (0-1, default 0.264)
